note:
R135a - which PS4 EB archives carry attrib vault members (`nhl/data/common/database/attrib/*.vlt|*.bin`) per install, with member size
and SHA-256 prefix of the unwrapped (chunkzip-decoded) payload, so the goalie-mask contract (package 3) measures each distinct vault source instead of assuming the
`Extracted` tree = the patched state. Also: the `Extracted` copy's file hashes for the same names. Read-only; listing + member hashing.
Usage: python r135a_ps4_attrib_sources.py <out.json>
